CREATE TABLE "public"."item_pricing_versions" (
  "base_unit" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "bulk_tiers" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "company_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_by_user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "item_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "package_label" character varying(20),
  "package_price_cents" int4,
  "package_size" int4,
  "preview_enabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "item_pricing_base_unit_present_169acc26" CHECK (length(btrim(base_unit)) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "item_pricing_package_valid_dbc7f253" CHECK ((package_label IS NULL AND package_size IS NULL AND package_price_cents IS NULL) OR (package_label IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(package_label)) > 0 AND package_size IS NOT NULL AND package_size > 1 AND package_price_cents IS NOT NULL AND package_price_cents >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT "item_pricing_tiers_array_47c3262c" CHECK (jsonb_typeof(bulk_tiers) = 'array'),
  CONSTRAINT "item_pricing_version_positive_341aaa74" CHECK (version > 0)
)
